about: [O6 after the critic, major 6] A man on the tram's rails (the bed, idle): the bell and `The tram. Off the rails.` while it comes; met, he is knocked aside off the rails and hurt by its speed - never carried along in front of its nose (the critic was pushed 175 m unhurt). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6_tram_foot.json

W.warned = +(tz - p.z).toFixed(1); if (W.hitAt == null && G.health.hp < 100) W.hitAt = [+p.x.toFixed(1), +p.z.toFixed(1)]; if (W.hitAt) W.maxCarry = Math.max(W.maxCarry, Math.abs(p.z - W.hitAt[1])); if (!W.stop) requestAnimationFrame(t); }; requestAnimationFrame(t); return 1; })()
